0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Giritt's eyes light up at your arrival.

24.original: Use the box of custom-made explosives to blow up the tempting bedrock.

26.original: Deliver the chunks of twinkling ore to Giritt.

49.original: ...That nervous thrill when you toss a bomb you've just made? The <hex:021A020203>satisfaction<hex:021A020103> of shattering a shelf of bedrock into tiny little pieces!? I pity the poor souls who've never known such joy!

50.original: You're a worldly <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, ain't you? Promise not to lecture me about “danger” and “scaring the beardlings” like my milksop neighbors, and I'll let you test my latest batch of explosives!

51.original: Take these beauties, and throw one at the bedrock east of the village. The explosion's a reward in itself, of course, but if you're lucky, you might also hit a seam of ore. Bring any promising chunks back to me, and I'll let you know what you've found!

52.original: Go and blow up some bedrock! There's a tempting outcrop just east of the village─toss a bomb at it, admire the destruction, then bring back any ore you find!

55.original: Oh! Oooh! Do you know what this is...!?

56.original: ...Iron ore.<hex:02100103>It's a bit shiny, aye, but otherwise naught special for this area.

57.original: Now, for the important part! How was the BOOM!? Wasn't it just the most amazing feeling ever!?

60.original: I thought I'd lose an eye...

61.original: See! I knew you'd appreciate a good explosion!

62.original: Ugh, you sound like my mother. I thought someone like you would... Well, never mind.

63.original: Here─a few coins for the ore. Thanks for testing the bombs!
